---
title: "Discard-sampling coverage explorer"
author: "Damian Villagra"
output: html_document
---

This app explores **discard-sampling provision** in ICES catch data, for discard
raising. You read in your `catch_data`, pick which columns to aggregate over
(starting from `fleetValue`, ticking on `seasonValue`, `areaValue`, …), and see
where discard estimates exist and where they are missing.

**Coverage logic**

* A *landings* record linked to a discard estimate has a non-`NA` `domainCatchDis`
  → that landings weight is *covered*.
* **Coverage %** in a stratum = covered landings weight / total landings weight.
* A stratum *has a discard estimate* if a `Dis` record exists for it **or** some
  of its landings are linked.
* `Dis` records with `total == 0` still count as sampled (discard rate 0).
* `numTrips` / `numPSUs` carry the sampling effort behind each estimate.

**How to run:** run the `setup`, `helpers`, `ui`, `server` chunks once (Run All
Chunks Above), then run the final `run-app` chunk whenever you want to (re)launch
the app. If a `catch_data` object is in your session it is used automatically when
no file is uploaded.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(readr)
library(DT)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 200 * 1024^2)   # allow larger uploads
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r helpers}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

# Columns the user may switch on/off as extra aggregation dimensions --------
GROUP_CANDIDATES <- c(
  "vesselFlagCountry", "fleetValue", "metier6", "areaValue", "seasonValue",
  "speciesCode", "stock", "fisheriesManagementUnit", "workingGroup"
)

# Columns offered as filters ------------------------------------------------
FILTER_CANDIDATES <- c(
  "vesselFlagCountry", "year", "workingGroup", "stock", "speciesCode",
  "areaValue", "metier6", "fleetValue", "seasonValue"
)

# ---- Read a catch-data file (rds / csv / tsv / xlsx) ----------------------
read_catch_file <- function(path, name) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(name))
  df <- switch(
    ext,
    rds  = readRDS(path),
    csv  = readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    tsv  = readr::read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    txt  = readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE),
    xls  = ,
    xlsx = {
      if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Install the 'readxl' package to read Excel files.")
      readxl::read_excel(path)
    },
    stop("Unsupported file type: .", ext)
  )
  as_tibble(df)
}

# ---- Standardise catch category to Landings / Discards --------------------
std_catch_cat <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Lan", "Landings", "L") ~ "Landings",
    x %in% c("Dis", "Discards", "D", "Logbook Registered Discard",
             "Regulated Discard", "BMS", "BMS landing") ~ "Discards",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

# ---- Type / column hygiene (no silent row loss) ---------------------------
prep_catch_data <- function(df) {
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  needed <- c("year", "catchCategory", "total", "fleetValue")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(df))
  if (length(missing))
    stop("Missing required column(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  # add any candidate / auxiliary columns that are absent so code stays safe
  aux <- unique(c(GROUP_CANDIDATES,
                  "domainCatchDis", "numPSUs", "numTrips", "PSU"))
  for (col in setdiff(aux, names(df))) df[[col]] <- NA

  df %>%
    mutate(
      year       = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)),
      total      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(total)),
      numTrips   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numTrips)),
      numPSUs    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numPSUs)),
      cat_std    = std_catch_cat(catchCategory),
      is_sampled = !is.na(domainCatchDis) & as.character(domainCatchDis) != ""
    )
}

# ---- Single stratum label from the chosen grouping columns ----------------
stratum_label <- function(df, group_cols) {
  if (!length(group_cols)) return(rep("All", nrow(df)))
  parts <- lapply(group_cols, function(cc)
    ifelse(is.na(df[[cc]]), "NA", as.character(df[[cc]])))
  do.call(paste, c(parts, sep = " | "))
}

# ---- Core: coverage + discard rate per (year x stratum) -------------------
compute_coverage <- function(df, group_cols) {
  keys <- c("year", group_cols)

  lan <- df %>%
    filter(cat_std == "Landings") %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
    summarise(
      landings         = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      covered_landings = sum(total * is_sampled, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  dis <- df %>%
    filter(cat_std == "Discards") %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) %>%
    summarise(
      discards      = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trips       = sum(numTrips, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_psu         = sum(numPSUs,  na.rm = TRUE),
      n_dis_records = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  res <- full_join(lan, dis, by = keys) %>%
    mutate(across(c(landings, covered_landings, discards,
                    n_trips, n_psu, n_dis_records),
                  ~ coalesce(.x, 0))) %>%
    mutate(
      has_discard  = discards > 0 | n_dis_records > 0 | covered_landings > 0,
      coverage_pct = if_else(landings > 0,
                             100 * covered_landings / landings, NA_real_),
      discard_rate = if_else(landings + discards > 0,
                             100 * discards / (landings + discards), NA_real_)
    )

  res$stratum <- stratum_label(res, group_cols)
  res
}

# ---- Coverage tile map (year x stratum) -----------------------------------
plot_coverage_map <- function(cov, fill_mode = "coverage") {
  ord <- cov %>%
    group_by(stratum) %>%
    summarise(tot = sum(landings, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(tot) %>% pull(stratum)

  cov <- cov %>%
    mutate(stratum = factor(stratum, levels = ord),
           year    = factor(year, levels = sort(unique(year))))

  p <- ggplot(cov, aes(x = year, y = stratum))

  if (fill_mode == "coverage") {
    p <- p +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = coverage_pct), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low = "#d73027", high = "#1a9850", limits = c(0, 100),
        na.value = "grey85",
        name = "Landings linked to a\ndiscard estimate (%)"
      )
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_tile(aes(fill = has_discard), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "#1a9850", "FALSE" = "#d73027"),
        labels = c("TRUE" = "Discard estimate present",
                   "FALSE" = "No discard estimate"),
        name = NULL
      )
  }

  p +
    labs(title = "Discard-sampling coverage by stratum and year",
         subtitle = "Strata ordered bottom \u2192 top by total landings weight",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid    = element_blank())
}

# ---- Discard-rate lines over time -----------------------------------------
plot_discard_rate <- function(cov) {
  ggplot(cov, aes(x = year, y = discard_rate / 100,
                  colour = stratum, group = stratum)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Discard rate", colour = "Stratum",
         title = "Discard rate over time by stratum") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13)
}

# ---- Wide table (stratum x year) for a chosen metric ----------------------
build_wide_table <- function(cov, group_cols, metric) {
  id_cols <- if (length(group_cols)) group_cols else "stratum"
  cov %>%
    mutate(value = round(.data[[metric]], 1)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_cols), year, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(across(all_of(id_cols)))
}

# ---- DT with red-green colouring for percentage metrics -------------------
render_coverage_dt <- function(wide, id_cols, percent_scale = TRUE) {
  year_cols <- setdiff(names(wide), id_cols)
  dt <- datatable(wide, rownames = FALSE, class = "stripe hover compact",
                  options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE))
  if (percent_scale && length(year_cols)) {
    brks <- seq(0, 100, length.out = 11)[-c(1, 11)]           # 10,20,...,90
    clrs <- colorRampPalette(c("#d73027", "#ffffbf", "#1a9850"))(length(brks) + 1)
    dt <- dt %>% formatStyle(columns = year_cols,
                             backgroundColor = styleInterval(brks, clrs),
                             color = "black")
  }
  dt
}
```

```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Discard-sampling coverage explorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      fileInput("file", "Catch data file (.rds / .csv / .xlsx)",
                accept = c(".rds", ".csv", ".tsv", ".txt", ".xlsx", ".xls")),
      checkboxInput("use_session",
                    "Use catch_data from R session if no file", TRUE),
      tags$hr(),
      uiOutput("group_ui"),
      tags$hr(),
      uiOutput("filter_ui"),
      tags$hr(),
      radioButtons("fill_mode", "Coverage map fill",
                   c("Coverage % (landings-weighted)" = "coverage",
                     "Any discard estimate (binary)"  = "binary")),
      radioButtons("table_metric", "Table metric",
                   c("Coverage %"     = "coverage_pct",
                     "Discard rate %" = "discard_rate",
                     "Landings"       = "landings",
                     "Discards"       = "discards",
                     "Sampled trips"  = "n_trips"))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      verbatimTextOutput("summary"),
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Coverage map", plotOutput("cov_map", height = "650px")),
        tabPanel("Discard rate", plotOutput("dr_plot", height = "650px")),
        tabPanel("Coverage table",
                 downloadButton("dl_table", "Download CSV"),
                 br(), br(), DTOutput("cov_table")),
        tabPanel("Filtered data", DTOutput("raw_table"))
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r server}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # --- load & prep raw data ------------------------------------------------
  raw_data <- reactive({
    if (!is.null(input$file)) {
      df <- read_catch_file(input$file$datapath, input$file$name)
    } else if (isTRUE(input$use_session) &&
               exists("catch_data", envir = globalenv())) {
      df <- get("catch_data", envir = globalenv())
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
    prep_catch_data(df)
  })

  # --- aggregation checkboxes (only columns present in the data) ----------
  output$group_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- raw_data(); req(df)
    choices <- intersect(GROUP_CANDIDATES, names(df))
    checkboxGroupInput("group_cols", "Aggregation levels",
                       choices  = choices,
                       selected = intersect("fleetValue", choices))
  })

  # --- dynamic filters -----------------------------------------------------
  output$filter_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- raw_data(); req(df)
    cols <- intersect(FILTER_CANDIDATES, names(df))
    lapply(cols, function(col) {
      vals <- sort(unique(as.character(df[[col]])))
      selectizeInput(paste0("flt_", col), col,
                     choices = vals, multiple = TRUE,
                     options = list(placeholder = "All"))
    })
  })

  group_cols <- reactive(input$group_cols %||% character(0))

  # --- apply filters -------------------------------------------------------
  filtered <- reactive({
    df <- raw_data(); req(df)
    cols <- intersect(FILTER_CANDIDATES, names(df))
    for (col in cols) {
      sel <- input[[paste0("flt_", col)]]
      if (!is.null(sel) && length(sel))
        df <- df %>% filter(as.character(.data[[col]]) %in% sel)
    }
    df
  })

  coverage <- reactive({
    df <- filtered(); req(df, nrow(df) > 0)
    compute_coverage(df, group_cols())
  })

  # --- summary line --------------------------------------------------------
  output$summary <- renderText({
    cov <- coverage(); req(cov)
    tot_lan <- sum(cov$landings)
    ov_cov  <- if (tot_lan > 0) 100 * sum(cov$covered_landings) / tot_lan else NA
    n_cells <- nrow(cov)
    n_with  <- sum(cov$has_discard)
    sprintf(
      paste0("Strata: %d   |   year\u00d7stratum cells: %d   |   ",
             "cells with a discard estimate: %d (%.0f%%)   |   ",
             "overall landings covered: %.1f%%"),
      dplyr::n_distinct(cov$stratum), n_cells, n_with,
      100 * n_with / n_cells, ov_cov)
  })

  # --- plots ---------------------------------------------------------------
  output$cov_map <- renderPlot({
    cov <- coverage(); req(cov); plot_coverage_map(cov, input$fill_mode)
  })
  output$dr_plot <- renderPlot({
    cov <- coverage(); req(cov); plot_discard_rate(cov)
  })

  # --- coverage table ------------------------------------------------------
  wide_tbl <- reactive({
    cov <- coverage(); req(cov)
    build_wide_table(cov, group_cols(), input$table_metric)
  })
  output$cov_table <- renderDT({
    w <- wide_tbl(); req(w)
    id_cols <- if (length(group_cols())) group_cols() else "stratum"
    render_coverage_dt(
      w, id_cols,
      percent_scale = input$table_metric %in% c("coverage_pct", "discard_rate"))
  })
  output$dl_table <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0("discard_", input$table_metric, ".csv"),
    content  = function(f) readr::write_csv(wide_tbl(), f)
  )

  # --- filtered raw data ---------------------------------------------------
  output$raw_table <- renderDT({
    df <- filtered(); req(df)
    datatable(df, rownames = FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
}
```

```{r run-app, eval=FALSE}
# Run this chunk to (re)launch the app.
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
